<div class="card-body">
'''Enhanced TIE Laser Cannon''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Starship Weapon]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">改良型タイ・レーザー・キャノン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1フォース消費してTIEに配備する。大型艦は、（運命数－2）＞装甲値ならば命中。宇宙戦闘機は、運命数＞回避値ならば命中する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Enhanced-TIE-Laser-Cannon-PSA-159081599.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">サイナー・フリート・システムズの最新試作型レーザー・キャノン。帝国軍タイのほぼ全機種に装備が可能で、戦闘力を向上させるが、モフたちの多くは、大量配備するには費用がかかりすぎると考えている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Improved TIE laser cannon.

'''Card text:'''
Use 1 Force to deploy on a TIE. A capital is hit if (destiny − 2) > armor. A starfighter is hit if destiny > maneuver.

'''Lore:'''
Sienar Fleet Systems' latest prototype laser cannon. It can be fitted on almost every Imperial TIE and raises firepower, but many Moffs think it costs too much for mass deployment.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 改良型タイ・レーザー・キャノン (improved TIE laser cannon).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Enhanced TIE Laser Cannon]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
